interface.shortDescription: US law search with verbatim citations, and US LLC formation. 美国法律检索与美国公司注册。
interface.longDescription:
Corpus searches US federal, state and municipal law ingested from official sources and returns a verbatim citation for every answer. It also runs the intake to form a US LLC or nonprofit corporation for founders anywhere, including outside the US; every filing is reviewed by a person before it goes to the state. Corpus forms US entities only. Winner, Track 4 (Autopilot Agent), Global AI Hackathon Series with Qwen Cloud: https://devpost.com/software/corpus-mcp

Corpus 检索美国联邦、州及市级法律（来自官方来源），每条回答附逐字引用；并可为全球创始人（包括美国境外）办理美国 LLC 或非营利公司注册，每份申请提交到州政府前均经人工审核。仅办理美国实体。Qwen Cloud 全球 AI 黑客松 Track 4（Autopilot Agent）获奖项目。
